items.title: Greeting with an f-string
items.prompt: Write `greet(name, n)` that returns `'Hi Ada, you have 3 new messages'`.
hints: Python's template strings start with f before the quote.
Inside an f-string, put expressions in {curly braces}.
return f"Hi {name}, you have ... new messages"
items.solution:
def greet(name, n):
    return f"Hi {name}, you have {n} new messages"
items.lesson: f-strings are Python's template literals: f"{expr}". Format specs go after a colon: f"{price:.2f}".
